title: What Agencies Build With Vibe Coding: Client Portals, Proposals, and Reporting Dashboards
summary: Agencies are replacing $800-1,500/month in per-seat tools by building custom client portals, reporting dashboards, and proposal generators with AI. Here are the 6 most-built tools.
body_markdown: Most client portals take 3–6 hours to build with Blink — from first prompt to a deployed tool with real client logins, project tracking, and a billing summary. More complex portals pulling from multiple ad platforms or requiring custom approval workflows may take a full day of iteration. That's still faster than onboarding a new SaaS subscription and configuring it for your workflow.
